messages:
maria_csm: Heads-up — planning a quota/limit adjustment for Voltworks next Tue (prod org: volt-prod). It’s a small cap decrease on their burst allowance to protect shared pool. Doing a dry-run of the customer comms sequence. Can folks review and flag any blockers? :spiral_calendar:

ryan_success_ops: Thanks Maria. Quick Q — what's the exact change (numbers)? Need to include current vs new in the note plus TTL for the change.

maria_csm: Current: burst cap 10 req/sec, sustained 5 req/sec. Proposed: burst cap 6 req/sec, sustained 5 req/sec. Change only affects burst window. No token cost changes. We'll monitor 48h post-change and auto-roll back if 5xx rate > 0.5% or avg latency increases > 40ms.

jamal_support: Can we get an engineering sign-off that 6 req/sec won't trip any internal client SDKs? Also need an escalation path in the message (support@ + priority alias).

ellie_comm: I drafted 2 short messaging variants (Slack + email). Want to A/B test subject lines and lead) Variant A subject: "Upcoming temporary quota adjustment — Voltworks" Variant B subject: "Action: Small burst limit change next week (Voltworks)" Email bodies are short, include what changed, why, how long, and contact. I’ll paste the templates below for quick review.

maria_csm: paste templates below

ellie_comm: ```Variant A (email):
Subject: Upcoming temporary quota adjustment for Voltworks
Hi Voltworks team —
We’re making a small adjustment to your burst request allowance on Tue 03/30 at 09:00 UTC to improve platform stability across shared pools. Burst cap will move from 10 req/sec to 6 req/sec; sustained cap remains 5 req/sec. We expect no change to your normal traffic. If you rely on short bursts for background jobs, please let us know so we can help configure a dedicated pool or reserved capacity.
If you see any client errors after 09:00 UTC, open a ticket at support@redwood.ai and reference case #RW-volt-burst. We will monitor and roll back if error rates rise above thresholds.
Thanks,
Maria (Your CSM)
```

ellie_comm: ```Variant B (email):
Subject: Action: Small burst limit change next week (Voltworks)
Hi —
We’re applying a small change to your burst allowance on Tue 03/30, 09:00 UTC: burst 10 -> 6 req/sec. This helps keep shared performance consistent. No sustained throughput changes. If your integration needs short-term bursts, we can recommend reserved capacity. Reply to this thread or contact support@redwood.ai.
Thanks, Ellie (Comms)
```

dan_eng: Quick eng note: implementation is a config toggle on the rate limiter. We can schedule at 09:00 UTC. I’ll add a canary rollout: 10% of traffic for first 10m, then 100% if metrics look good. Rollback hook exists. I’ll post the PromQL checks we’ll monitor.

dan_eng: ```promql
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",env="prod",customer="volt-prod",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",env="prod",customer="volt-prod"}[5m])) > 0.005
```

jamal_support: Good. For customer-facing copy we should add: expected impact (none for typical traffic), how to test (example curl), and timeframe for follow-up. Also add an explicit fallback ETA (we’ll revert within 30m of anomaly).

maria_csm: add example curl snippet?

jamal_support: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

ellie_comm: I’ll update templates with the curl and fallback ETA. Proposed timeline: send notice email + Slack DM to Voltworks primary on Fri 03/27 (72h notice), reminder 1h before change, apply canary at 09:00 UTC Tue 03/30, full rollout 09:10 if healthy, monitor 48h.

ryan_success_ops: Add to weekly account health check on Mon 03/29 so we can catch any last-minute onboarding or integration concerns. Also schedule a 15m warmline for the CSMs during the rollout window.

maria_csm: assigning owners: Ellie: finalize comm templates and run A/B variant to me by Thu EOD. Dan: implement canary + alert playbook by Mon EOD. Jamal: prepare support responders and quick triage doc. Ryan: schedule account health slot and warmline. I’ll send the draft email Friday.

ellie_comm: acked. I’ll attach both variants to the Friday send for Maria to choose.

dan_eng: marking the config as planned in infra-change-log. I’ll send the Prometheus query and dashboard link when ready.

notify-bot: Reminder set — thread reminder on 1797820000 for "Finalize Voltworks comms"

maria_csm: Thanks all. If anyone expects Voltworks to spike traffic Friday (billing/job runs), flag here now. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the dry-run schedule and treat this as a template for similar small quota changes going forward. :white_check_mark:
